احتملتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَلْتُنَّ (iḥtamaltunna) /iħ.ta.mal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اُحْتُمِلْتُنَّ (uḥtumiltunna) /uħ.tu.mil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
